$comment: Structured evidence for the #707 five-criterion candidate gate (PR #723 review response). A document's spec_maturity may be "candidate" in family-manifest.json only if scripts/check-family-manifest.mjs's candidate-gate check resolves, for that document, all of: (1) requirement_inventory.attested is true with a non-empty audited_by that is a real, existing commit SHA (verified against git history, not merely well-formed) recording a dedicated completeness audit, not inferred from a '# Conformance' heading, which proves a floor exists but not that it is complete, AND requirement_inventory.report names a durable, versioned audit report (report.path, an existing file in this repository, and report.document_sha256, a 64-hex sha256 of the audited document as of the audit commit): a bare attested/audited_by pair is not itself an auditable record (PR #727 review); (2) every decide_issue_scope entry naming this document's slug has a matching decide_resolutions entry with status 'resolved_in_tree' and a commit that exists in git history, or the document fails; (3) the document has a real Conformance section (checked structurally elsewhere): representative implementation evidence is displayed beside spec maturity in each document's family-status block, never gated as a coverage threshold, per the ruling's own text; (4) the document contains at least one '~~~' artwork block, or examples_waiver.reason is a non-empty, explicit proportionality statement; (5) unstable external normative dependencies are disclosed via DEPENDENCIES.md's generated external-normative-ids block (scripts/check-family-manifest.mjs check (q)), which needs no separate field here. A report whose document_sha256 no longer matches conformance-manifest.json's current content_sha256 for that file prints a non-fatal staleness warning (a family-status regen changes bytes mechanically and should not by itself force a re-audit); the check never fails on staleness alone.

examples_waiver.reason: Single-member RFC 3339 date-time format profile with a two-item Conformance checklist; the format itself (a date-time value) is the only wire content, and a worked example would restate the RFC 3339 grammar rather than illustrate anything specific to this profile. Proportionality judgment, not an unconditional exemption: reversed the moment this document gains any structure beyond the one member.
